usefulness.rationale: Only identity anchors and a set of unjustified conclusions were supplied; the dossier and retainedSources arrays are empty. A reader gets bare facts (born 1953 Kinnigoli, cardiac surgeon, founder/chairman of Narayana Health, trained at Kasturba Medical College and Guy's Hospital) but no cited evidence, no career detail, no dates beyond birth. The three flagged conclusions (Toronto affiliation, personal treatment of all 24 centres' patients, world's cheapest heart surgery) are useful cautions but are conclusions, not dossier statements with citations, so no overclaims with verbatim excerpts can be assessed.
